optim: AdamW lr3e-4 cosine to3e-5; weight_decay1e-4; gradient_clip1
random_initialization: All task/state/readout/transition weights new; only frozen pretrained DINO reused
geometry_supervision: training-only XYZ/size, region and physical Held; same in both structures; no support/contact/on labels
state_holdout_model_scope: Four-frame current visual state estimator, no GRU history; tests joint visual configuration and feedback non-target preservation. Four-frame image windows still checked against holdout.
test_protocol: No final test labels/predictions inspected for tuning; collect/evaluate once after engineering and development freeze; exposed engineering seeds never final test
development_selection: Lowest development loss among models with current/one-step/root-end joint >=.98; otherwise best minimum of these then loss, marked basic ability failure
planning: Finite candidates evaluated by model successors; no predicted feasible program => stop; skill/physics failure => stop; no fallback

state.holdout_definition: No large=B AND small=Held at any training/development observation, target, four-frame input or trajectory history
state.positive_control: In 30/60 training groups and 10/20 development groups, replace A_smallB_releaseB by B_smallB_releaseB; same small actor/action/target counts, retain 30 A examples and add 30 B examples.
state.sample_budget: 360 train episodes / 960 transitions per arm; 120 development episodes; same updates.

transition.holdout_definition: No loaded large B→A transition in training/development; loaded large B terminal states remain allowed
transition.positive_control: In 30/60 training groups and 10/20 development groups, replace empty B→A by loaded B→A; same large actor, direction, destination and action counts, retain 30 empty reverse examples and add 30 loaded reverse examples.
transition.sample_budget: 360 train episodes / 960 transitions per arm; 120 development episodes; same updates.
